name: AI for Computational Biology
description: The course will be an attempt to look at how ideas and tools from AI and computational modelling can be applied to understand the workings of living organisms: including specific topics such as computational genomics, phylogenetics, evolutionary modelling, gene regulatory networks and systems biology, biological graphs and networks, and structural biology.
